title: Belgium leads the week's risk fallers

subSegments.t: Where the QGI-GPR signal fell most, the week of May 25.
fell most, with no clear driver behind the move. Weekly falls can reflect a shift in coverage mix, not real de-escalation.

axis: QGI-GPR change, week of May 25 vs May 18, 2026
note: 44 validated countries · weekly share of risk-flagged news coverage · a fall is a smaller share of risk-flagged coverage, not necessarily lower real risk
foot: GPR is movement in the risk signal, not its level. Not a forecast.
